mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative >30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (>0.5pp over 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will lead to a slowdown in consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the Fed funds rate is below 2%, it signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that will lead to negative real returns and drive S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show y-o-y declines for two consecutive months, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline y-o-y for 2 months
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline y-o-y for 2 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (>100k jobs added per month for 3 consecutive months) signals a tightening labor market that will lead to wage inflation and drive S&P 500 returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 100k for 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative >30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 55 for two consecutive months, it signals a strengthening of industrial activity that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 for 2 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative >30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the Fed funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI inflation rate is below 2%, it signals a high-rate, low-inflation environment that will suppress economic activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.
